hooks.command: bash -c 'v=$(cat | jq -r ".$1 // empty" 2>/dev/null); fail=; if [ -n "$5" ] && [ -z "$v" ]; then fail=1; fi; if [ -n "$2" ] && [[ "$v" =~ $2 ]]; then fail=1; fi; if [ -n "$3" ] && ! [[ "$v" =~ $3 ]]; then fail=1; fi; if [ -n "$fail" ]; then printf "%s\n" "$4"; exit 2; fi' bluetemberg 'name' '^claude/' '' 'EnterWorktree requires a conventional branch name. Call EnterWorktree again with name="type/description" (e.g. feat/my-feature). Ask the user what the branch should be called if unclear. Types: feat fix chore refactor docs test' '1'
